389:t_1:5.en:
$$ランド$$
「We've been together a long time now...」

389:t_1:6.en:
$$ランド$$
「Ever since the Boss disappeared, you, $$メール$$ and I have charged ahead together. But I guess I still don't understand you...」

389:t_1:7.en:
$$ランド$$
「...Lend me your strength, $$ガンレオン$$.」

389:t_1:8.en:
$$ランド$$
「$n's risking his life out there. If I, his smile teacher, can't bring out your strength, that's just pathetic...」

389:t_1:9.en:
$$ティティ$$
「...What's he doing over there?」

389:t_1:10.en:
$$メール$$
「Darling's been worrying all this time... He says he can't draw out $$ガンレオン$$'s real power...」

389:t_1:11.en:
$$ティティ$$
「What do you mean, its real power...?」

389:t_1:12.en:
$$メール$$
「It can always fight in $$マグナモード$$ now, so it's actually stronger than it was before, but...」

389:t_1:13.en:
$$メール$$
「Darling says $$ガンレオン$$'s power goes way beyond that.」

389:t_1:14.en:
$$ティティ$$
「So he can't bring out the $$スフィア$$'s power.」

389:t_1:16.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Hmm... I guess facing such overwhelming power has made him shrink back...」

389:t_1:17.en:
$$メール$$
「What do you mean, overwhelming power...?」

389:t_1:18.en:
$$クロウ$$
「It looks like $$ランド$$'s hit a wall.」

389:t_1:20.en:
$$クロウ$$
「If his fiancee looks so gloomy, your beloved Darling's going to worry too.」

389:t_1:22.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Hey, debt boy! If you came to tease him, go away.」

389:t_1:23.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Don't be so cold, $$ティティ$$. I brought a plan to save $$ランド$$.」

389:t_1:24.en:
$$メール$$
「A plan!? You can come up with one, $$クロウ$$!?」

389:t_1:25.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Believe it or not, I've watched $$ゼロ$$ of the $$黒の騎士団$$ and Miss $$スメラギ$$ of $$ソレスタルビーイング$$ up close.」

389:t_1:26.en:
$$クロウ$$
「First things first. We need to gather the crew.」

389:t_1:35.en:
$$ランド$$
「...What the hell is this group? Why's the average age so damn high?」

389:t_1:39.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I'm calling it $$ミッション・スプリング$$.」

389:t_1:40.en:
$$ランド$$
「$$クロウ$$... Has your debt given you a fever?」

389:t_1:41.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Well... I wouldn't expect that brain of yours to understand.」

389:t_1:42.en:
$$ランド$$
「What the hell did you say!?」

389:t_1:45.en:
$$クロウ$$
「The $$傷だらけの獅子$$ $$スフィア$$ unleashes its power by enduring pain...」

389:t_1:46.en:
$$クロウ$$
「But you're its $$リアクター$$, and you forget to endure anything. You just let your anger out right away. That won't do.」

389:t_1:48.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Don't worry. $$ミッション・スプリング$$ will retrain you from scratch.」

389:t_1:50.en:
$$クロウ$$
「When you push a spring down hard, it rebounds with a lot of force, right? That's the idea.」

389:t_1:51.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Plus, $$ランド$$'s been edging into old-man territory lately. I want him to remember his youth, the springtime of life. It's a double meaning.」

389:t_1:53.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Oh no! $n's spirit is on the verge of dying again!」

389:t_1:54.en:
$$イアン$$
「He's just fed up, that's all...」

389:t_1:55.en:
$$オットー$$
「...I understand the idea, but why did you go to the trouble of gathering us?」

389:t_1:56.en:
$$オットー$$
「This may be our break, but I am still this ship's captain.」

389:t_1:57.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I simply hoped to borrow the strength of our esteemed elders to help $$ランド$$ regain his youth.」

389:t_1:59.en:
$$シャア$$
「I... belong in that category too...?」

389:t_1:60.en:
$$アムロ$$
「So do I, even though I couldn't be a father figure to $$クェス$$...?」

389:t_1:61.en:
$$アストナージ$$
「Come now, Captain, Colonel. You can think of this as another part of being a team leader.」

389:t_1:62.en:
$$大杉$$
「Quite right. It's nice to see such an unusual group of faces together.」

389:t_1:63.en:
$$ランド$$
「So... I've been edging into this crowd's territory...」

389:t_1:64.en:
$$クロウ$$
「See you, $$ランド$$. Good luck with the rest.」

389:t_1:65.en:
$n
「Please let me know if there's anything I can do. I'll help.」

389:t_1:66.en:
$$クロウ$$
「No, $n. Your youth won't help this time.」

389:t_1:67.en:
$$クロウ$$
「That's the deal. I'm expecting results, $$ランド$$.」

389:t_1:68.en:
$$ランド$$
「What's all this about youth...? He's got one foot in old-man territory himself, mentally.」

389:t_1:69.en:
$$アムロ$$
「...Well, what shall we do? Since this is training, how about a mock battle?」

389:t_1:70.en:
$$シャア$$
「But that would leave most of the people gathered here with nothing to do.」

389:t_1:71.en:
$$オットー$$
「This doesn't make sense in the first place... If he wanted seasoned veterans of life, why didn't he invite Commander $$ブライト$$?」

389:t_1:72.en:
$$オットー$$
「Every day, he battles stress as a ship captain, a fleet commander and a father.」

389:t_1:73.en:
$$オットー$$
「Or is that it? He decided the commander was busy, but I had nothing to do, so he called me?」

389:t_1:75.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「Really, that man $$クロウ$$ has no sense of courtesy.」

389:t_1:76.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「Since he came from special forces, I offered him a place in $$エコーズ$$, and all he would talk about was the pay.」

389:t_1:77.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「No... It isn't just him. Young people put their own interests first and neglect military discipline and their sense of duty.」

389:t_1:78.en:
$$ランド$$
「Well... $$クロウ$$ and the youngsters have their own circumstances...」

389:t_1:79.en:
$$大杉$$
「Oh, Major $$コンロイ$$, that certainly isn't limited to $$エコーズ$$.」

389:t_1:81.en:
$$厚井$$
「I'm sure $$アストナージ$$ and $$イアン$$ feel the same way.」

389:t_1:82.en:
$$アストナージ$$
「We do. Just when I think they're waiting for orders, they go and do something completely outrageous.」

389:t_1:83.en:
$$イアン$$
「I know what you mean, $$アストナージ$$. Warn them, and they complain we don't understand young people, or we're a burden in our old age...」

389:t_1:84.en:
$$カシオ$$
「And they even poke at our sore spots without a second thought: our smelly feet, thinning hair, bulging bellies...」

389:t_1:85.en:
$$ランド$$
「I don't think they go quite that far...」
